section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Case and Brake)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Case and Brake)

content.description: Exploded view showing ring gear, thrust washer, thrust bearing, races, and overdrive case components

items: REMOVE RING GEAR AND THRUST WASHER
REMOVE THRUST BEARING AND RACES FROM OVERDRIVE CASE

content.text: Note the position of the races.

content.description: Hand removing snap ring, spring retainer and return springs from overdrive case

items: REMOVE SNAP RING, SPRING RETAINER AND RETURN SPRINGS

content.description: Hand using compressed air through case hole to remove brake piston

content.text: Blow compressed air through the case hole indicated in the figure to pop out the brake piston.
If the piston does not pop out, lift it out with needle-nose pliers.

content.description: Hands removing oil seal rings and O-rings from overdrive case and piston

items: REMOVE TWO OIL SEAL RINGS FROM OVERDRIVE CASE

content.text: INSPECTION OF OVERDRIVE CASE AND BRAKE
Check that the sliding surface of disc is not worn or burnt. If the disc is worn or burnt, replace all discs.
Then check that the sliding surfaces of plate and flange are not worn or burnt.
NOTE: Do not allow the discs to dry out. Prepare new discs by soaking them at least two hours in ATF.
